items.basis: The self-proof table is present. I reran more than three of its commands and every one matched. ADR 0027:32/46/48, ADR 0052:250/264-269/279/285/296/300/306-308/353/364, store.rs:251-264/317-318/653 (:466-467 really is the statfs code, so the drift note holds) and book.rs:93/106-107/117-124 all match word for word. #1340 :259/330/331/336/344-348/363/382 match, including the C10.3 sentence at :346. 28G :170/220/273/446, #1382:11-12, #1769:12-13, #1718:17-18, #1524:2/7 and #1525:26 match. The AGENTS, CONTEXT, chong-traceability, INTERFACE-CONTRACTS, SKILL, service/session_transport/job/s_structure_session and ADR 0038/0039/0028/0041/0051/0020/0023 lines also match. Comments 6452353777 (#1523, 2026-10-27T20:07:10Z, contains 'paper/live 同核'), 5596449009 (#1329, contains 'paper/live同核适配边界'), 6261281111 (#1323 notes-N-1), 6404224455 and 6465991201 all exist, are by xy7365527-lang, and say what the draft says. The block is because some citations in the body have no row in the table: the 考古对照 Q13 row cites 'ADR 0052:3-5' and 'ADR 0038:1-3', and the Q8 自由度 paragraph cites 'ADR 0033 系撮合模型' with no line number. The text at ADR 0052:3-5 and 0038:1-3 is correct (the 正本/最后裁定 header lines); it just has no table row. Fix: add self-proof rows for ADR 0052:3-5 and ADR 0038:1-3, and give ADR 0033 a line number with a matching row (ADR 0033:48 version-contract fields, as ADR 0052:266 cites it).

No conflict with ADR 0027:46/48, ADR 0039:270/272, ADR 0052:296 ('不设可选值'), ADR 0051:172, ADR 0028:28, #799 (AGENTS.md:48), #804 (:70) or ADR 0041:13/15. The clock kind is derived from evidence_class, so it is correctly not made a tunable field; ADR 0052:296 already rules that simulation has no alternative value. Persistence and inter-domain transport are not swapped per mode, which follows directly from C09.1/C09.2 and the ADR 0038 H2 recovery check. Q8 record-and-replay is a single model_id value, chosen once before the run. It never changes value at runtime, has no fallback, and a mismatch is a hard error, so it is not two strictness levels of the same judgment. Q10 keeps one schema; the format string is only a source label. Q11 keeps deadlines as resource gates, sends timeouts to failure, and adds no fault kind, consistent with ADR 0027:32 and ADR 0052:300. Nothing was excluded that should have been left as a legitimate choice, and nothing settled was made tunable.

This ticket's ten acceptance items are all executable with binary outcomes (test -f, rg -c/-F, gh state, comment-prefix count, the 承接登记 loop, the exact blocking-edge string, open blocked_by = 0). But the test lock this ticket rules on, ruling seven (c), is not decidable as written. It requires the replay simulation session to equal the original experiment/production session on all six faces, and says 'any difference outside the closed rename set is FAIL'. Ruling four, however, requires E to accept only the 受控撮合原件 format in a simulation session, so the face-4 raw originals in the original session (场所 adapter 原件 format) necessarily differ from the replay session's. That format label is not in the closed rename set (会话/运行 ID, make_token, first_known_ns/commit_ns, adapter 身份, evidence_class 标签). Read literally, recorded_venue_replay_six_faces_equal can never pass; reading format as 'adapter 身份' is a matter of interpretation, so the result is not binary. Fix: in ruling seven (c), state whether replay originals keep the original format or are relabeled, and if relabeled, add 'E 原件 format 标签（场所 adapter 原件↔受控撮合原件，一一对应）' to the closed rename set explicitly. Also state how the 'TestOnly 夹具原件只配 TestOnly 时钟' constraint in ruling four relates to the replay session.

The canonical landing places are docs/adr/NNNN-three-mode-shared-core-adapter-boundary.md plus one CONTEXT.md glossary entry, both inside the allowed scope. The ruling covers only the shared-core faces, adapter owners and swap table, clock enum, E schema, authority exclusivity and the test lock. It explicitly hands venue accounts, permissions and endpoints to #1540 and the single ledger / crosswalk to #1539. It does not touch funding parameters, real accounts or Destination, and does not change any code. No P-class choice is mixed in.

No new strict/lenient pair for the same judgment and no failure fallback. The clock is a closed enum bound to evidence_class. Inter-domain transport and persistence keep one implementation, with simulation explicitly barred from in-memory storage or disabled fsync. A replay mismatch is a hard stop that does not fall back to cross. A format mismatch returns SchemaUnsupported, writes no row and does not route to another check. A timeout is a failure with no retry and no switch of criteria. TestOnly is limited to component fixtures and rejected by production_session; that is a separate scope, not a second tier of the same judgment.

Edges check out: #1538 blocking = [1362,1366,1367,1525,1539,1540,1550], and blocked_by #1533/#1536 are both closed. The draft's edge readings for #1382 (by 1362,1363,1366,1365,1353), #1523, #1524 (1366,1769) and #1525 are correct, and the transitive-constraint argument for adding no direct edges holds. But the list of affected tickets is incomplete. A search for 1538 finds #1400 (TB-08-B, named-venue read-only capability and fact completeness feeding the session, OPEN). Its comment registers in writing that '完整adapter边界受#1538约束'. Its delivery (identity/order/position/report-frontier queries, the C10.5 capability evidence, the single fact source) falls directly under ruling three's matcher/venue row and ruling six. The draft lists neither its consumption nor its registration. Fix: add #1400 to the affected-tickets list (consumes rulings three and six, does not change its AC, transitively constrained via #1382/#1366, no new edge), and add 1400 to the 承接登记 acceptance loop.

The classifier verdict is correct. The ticket rules on the interface seam and owner placement between the shared core and the feed/clock/matcher/venue/transport/persistence adapters, plus the same-input equivalence test lock. Those fall under the T-class criteria in graph-engineering.md 1 (interface and seam, owner placement, test lock, recovery semantics). There is authority to cite: ADR 0027:46/48 (verified), ADR 0038:47/80 dual-run, ADR 0039:272 and ADR 0052. Funding parameters and real venues/accounts/permissions are outside it and belong to #1539/#1540, so it is not P-class.

Archaeology is present (A 7, B 7, C 0). I reran six queries and every count matches the record: rg '同核' over docs/adr .chanlun/definitions CONTEXT.md = 12; evidence_class in rust/src trading_system scripts tests = 1; Matcher/Venue/Feed/Adapter traits = 0; rg -l session_transport = 11; pub trait = 2; logical-bar/1|逻辑时钟 = 6. I re-searched the B points with different wording: Q8 with 录放|回报脚本|record replay|recorded venue|重放.*回报 across the repo, plus gh search '回报 重放' (0 results); Q4 with clock.kind|时钟 kind|wall-clock. Nothing earlier or conflicting turned up; only ADR 0051:172/238 and ADR 0052:177/296, which agree with the draft. The draft's 考古对照 covers all 14 of Q1–Q14. A points are adopted as-is and not reopened, each B point has queries and sources and is presented as a default value, there is no C point, and no question asks the user for a number.
